theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_cc_psf_param_continuity
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ₀ : Measure (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (xs : ℕ → Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), μ₀ univ ≠ ∞ → Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → (∀ i, 0 < lams i) → 0 < lam → Tendsto xs atTop (𝓝 x) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 lam) → Tendsto (fun i => ∫ v, f v ∂(ENNReal.ofReal ((lams i)⁻¹ ^ n) • μ₀.map (dilation (xs i) (lams i)))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ v, f v ∂(ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • μ₀.map (dilation x lam))))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
